extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users: signing officials (SOs), principal investigators (PIs), grant administrators, and external referees
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and requirements for starting, editing, routing, submitting, viewing, and deleting relinquishing statements (change-of-institution), managing Non-Research post-award amendments (via the Non-Research module and ASSIST), responding to Requests for Additional Materials (RAM), and submitting reference letters through eRA Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing statement statuses and permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines the possible statuses of a relinquishing statement and what SOs, PIs, and agency staff can do in each status: SO Work in Progress, PD/PI Work in Progress, Submitted to Agency, Accepted for Consideration, Returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO Work in Progress: SOs can edit, save, delete (deletion only allowed in this status), route to PI, or submit. PD/PI Work in Progress: the Contact PI sees a Relinquishing Statement action and can edit receiving organization and contact email; while routed to PI, SOs can only view the read-only form or routing history. Submitted to Agency: SO has clicked Submit; status changes to Submitted to Agency and the statement cannot be edited or deleted; SO can only view a PDF or routing history. Accepted for Consideration: the awarding agency is reviewing the request; SOs can only view a read-only PDF or routing history; the agency will either approve or set status to Returned. Returned: the agency has evaluated and returned the statement for corrections; SO can edit and view agency comments in Routing History.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility and search for starting a new relinquishing statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards eligible to start a relinquishing statement are those within the current budget period and must be found via the Relinquishing Statement search using the Not Started Search Type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An SO must log in with SO credentials, go to Status module, select Relinquishing Statements from Search Type, and choose Not Started to find grants eligible to relinquish. Use the three-dot ellipsis menu for a grant and select Start a New Relinquishing Statement. NOTE: You can email the PD/PI by clicking the PD/PI name at the top of the screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization identification and verification (New Institution)
rubrics_metrics.description: When identifying the organization to which the award is being transferred, choose either name (from suggestion list), UEI, or IPF number; a Verify action and Verified symbol indicate a valid match.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type the organization's name and select from the suggestion list, OR type the organization's unique entity identifier (UEI), OR type the organization’s IPF number. If a valid match is found, a Verified symbol appears and all three fields fill out. If you enter a UEI or IPF code, a Verify button appears which you must click. To clear identifier fields, click Clear and Start Over next to the UEI or IPF field. TIP: To clear the identifier fields, click a Clear and Start Over link next to the UEI or IPF fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing statement required fields and validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain fields are required and validated when creating a relinquishing statement: termination date, contact email at NEW organization, and financials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter the requested termination date (must be within the current project period), the contact email at the NEW organization, and optionally list equipment to transfer. Enter the Direct Cost (required) and optionally the Indirect Cost. If you try to route or submit without saving, the system prompts you to save first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save / Route to PI / Submit behaviors and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules about Save, Route to PI, and Submit actions and what they do to status and editability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click Save to save the relinquishing statement; after saving the form, its name changes to Edit Relinquishing Statement and status changes to SO Work in Progress. Once saved, clicking Cancel will NOT discard the form. Click Route to PI so the PI can review/edit; status changes to PD/PI Work in Progress and SOs can only view read-only or routing history. Route actions open a Relinquishing Statement comments popup. Click Submit to Agency to submit the relinquishing statement; status changes to Submitted to Agency. After Submit, you cannot edit or delete the statement and SOs can only view a PDF or routing history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleting relinquishing statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Deletion is restricted to SOs and only when the statement is in SO Work in Progress status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To delete, the relinquishing statement must be in SO Work in Progress. If already submitted to the agency or routed to the PI, you can only view a read-only copy and deletion is not allowed. Deletion action is available from the three-dot ellipsis menu when viewing Search for Awards results for SO Work in Progress statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing relinquishing statements (SO and PI permissions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Who can edit which fields and under which statuses: SOs can edit in SO Work in Progress or Returned; PIs can edit limited fields when routed to them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To edit a relinquishing statement, its status must be SO Work in Progress or Returned (SO). SOs use Search for Awards and select Edit Relinquishing Statement. If routed to PI, the PI can edit only the organization to which the grant is moving and the contact email at the receiving organization; all other fields are disabled. After PI edits, they route back to an SO; when routing back choose an SO and optionally enter comments which appear in Routing History; the chosen SO receives a notification email.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing relinquishing statement and routing history
rubrics_metrics.description: How to view the submitted/relinquished form and routing comments from Status screens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From Status Information screen, click the Relinquishing Statement link under Other Relevant Documents to view the Relinquishing Statement PDF. The Routing History popup shows all routing actions including date, relinquishing statement status, and comments entered by persons who did the routing. Routing history can be viewed in any status. If a relinquishing statement is Submitted to Agency, the SO sees a PDF; if routed to PI, the SO sees a read-only form on the Relinquishing Statement screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted for Consideration behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: When a relinquishing statement is in Accepted for Consideration status, the agency is reviewing it and certain user actions are limited; you may start a new relinquishing statement for the same award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While in Accepted for Consideration status, SOs can only view a read-only PDF or routing history. The agency will either approve or mark as Returned. If a relinquishing statement is in Accepted for Consideration, you can start a new relinquishing statement for the same award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Research amendment types
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates the types of Non-Research post-award amendments that can be requested in the Non-Research module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The types of amendments you can request are: Budget Revision; Carryover Request; Change in scope; Key Personnel; Merger, Transfer, etc; No Cost Extension; Organization Change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiating Non-Research amendments via ASSIST (PI and SO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Process and requirements to initiate a Non-Research amendment which opens ASSIST; both PIs and SOs have entry points but different search scopes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the Non Research module, use the Manage Post Award Amendments: Search or View screens and select Initiate Application in ASSIST, then fill out required application data in ASSIST. The application includes the main SF424 form and other required forms based on amendment type; each tab navigates to that form. NOTE: It is important to check the SAM registration to be sure that the expiration date is after the submission date. PIs see only their own awards eligible for amendments; SOs can search across their organization using the search criteria available to SOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing and managing Non-Research amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: How SOs and PIs view amendment records and PDFs and how to use search and View Amendments screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards that have had amendments submitted have a View action under the three-dot ellipsis menu. Select View Amendments to see the Manage Post Award Amendments: View screen, which lists all amendments associated with the award. From the View screen you can click the linked Amendment Application # to view a PDF of the application. SOs must enter search criteria and may add multiple ICs; PIs see their non-research amendments listed by default. Optionally mark Include Expired Segments to show awards with past project end dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Additional Materials (RAM) upload and submission rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and UI behaviors for responding to RAMs for Non-Research amendments: file upload, comments, save/submit/preview, limits, and audit trail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access RAM via the three-dot ellipsis menu and Submit RAM Response (RAM Request). Drag and drop file(s) or browse to upload; the drop files area specifies how many files and what file types are allowed. For uploaded files you can click the Download icon to open/download the file and the Delete icon to remove the file. Add comments in Please Provide Comments field. Click Save to save the uploaded submission package but not submit; click Submit to submit to agency; click Preview to see a PDF consisting of upload details plus contents of uploaded files. When submitted, an email notification is sent to GPO, GTA and GMS. About RAM specifics: there can only be one active (non-submitted) RAM request at a time to which changes can be made by authorized users; once submitted, a new RAM is required for additional changes; there is no limit to the number of RAMs a user can submit; both PI and SO can edit the RAM; the system provides an audit trail of who uploaded documents; the submission to the agency is one PDF with all documents combined. TIP: Check all documents after uploading to ensure the correct ones have been submitted. View Prior RAM option appears only if prior RAMs exist; Edit RAM option does not appear for awarded applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: RAM preview ordering and consolidated PDF behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Preview shows a consolidated list/PDF of uploaded documents with the latest on top; submission produces a single combined PDF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can click Preview to see a consolidated list of all documents uploaded for RAM submission, with the latest on top. The submission to the agency is one PDF with all documents combined. Click View Prior RAM under the three-dot ellipsis menu to view a consolidated PDF of all prior materials uploaded for a RAM (only if prior RAM exists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letter eligibility and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how an external referee may submit a reference letter via eRA Commons and the account requirements for the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference letters can be submitted any time after the NOFO is posted and no later than the application submission deadline. Reference letters cannot be accepted through any means other than eRA Commons. You (the referee) do not need to log in to eRA Commons to submit, but the candidate must have a valid Commons account and hold the PI role; otherwise you will receive an error. The candidate's SO, AA, or AO must assign the PI role to the candidate's Commons account if missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letter technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: File format and length rules for reference letters submitted to eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The letter must be no longer than two pages, not password-protected, and in flattened PDF format (not a fillable form PDF). NOTE: For Fellowship applications and Career Development programs a Letter of Reference form is no longer required; a letter written on university letterhead or similar is acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letter submission steps and replacement rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Required information for submission, confirmation behavior, and how to replace an already-submitted reference letter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before starting you need the applicant's Commons User ID, applicant's last name as it appears on Commons, the NOFO/opportunity number, and the deadline. If replacing a previously-submitted letter, you need the confirmation number from the first submission. Steps: Access Commons login page, click Submit a Reference Letter link, fill required fields (red asterisk), click Continue to upload the flattened PDF (<=2 pages), then Submit. After submitting a message appears showing a confirmation number and you receive an email with it. The candidate receives a confirmation email that the letter was submitted but cannot see the reference letter. IMPORTANT: Note the confirmation number; to update (replace) a reference letter you must have this confirmation number available. See Replacing an Already-Submitted Reference Letter for details.
